VMware ESXi Security Hardening Tool 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Launches an API service to generate VMware ESXi 8.0 security hardening configurations aligned with industry best practices.
- Supports flexible hardening profiles selectable by category (firewall, authentication, logging, services).
- Delivers configuration files (YAML, firewall rules, audit policies) with a detailed summary of applied policies.
- Provides endpoints for health checks, generating configurations, and listing available hardening options.
- Includes tiered pricing for Free, Developer, Professional, and Enterprise usage plans.
